title: Israel Warns Iran About the Bomb. It Built Its Own in Secret #shorts
description:
This week Netanyahu warned that an Iranian bomb would mean a "second Holocaust". In 1960 Israel was secretly building its own at Dimona, and it has never admitted it.

The full story: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8vyJuBw-Q2Y
